doc: Gil hunter REGEN 11-20 (owner: the 13 live 3D models are broken): RECIPE_95 steps crop/edit/prep/meshy from the 11-19 turnaround (~/gens/v95-latest-ta-1119/gil.webp, copied to <raw>/art/turnaround.png by hand), meshy-7.1 multi-image A-pose; then meshy_task.py remesh quad 60k and tools/art1/v95_to_game.py Gil --weights meshy. Variants: A the four sheet views as drawn, B front/side/back-three-quarter/back, C the arms-clear Meshy edits (arms a hand's width off the coat).
name: gil
edits_common: Edit this character turnaround view of a blue fish-man wizard. Keep EVERYTHING exactly as drawn: the fish head, big round eyes, the open fish mouth, blue scales, pale belly, the dark navy polka-dot coat with orange trims, the pointed wizard hat with its orange band, the brown satchel and strap, the fish tail and fins, the orange-striped boots with curled toes, colours, proportions, framing and the grey background. Change ONLY the arms: both arms hang in a relaxed A-pose about 30 degrees out from the body, a clear gap of grey background between each arm and sleeve and the coat, hands open, fingers together.

edits.tq: This is his three-quarter front view.
